page.title: Christmas, the Melusine way.
page.intro: No obligatory Christmas set menu. We’ll keep cooking the seasonal seafood we love, with dishes changing according to what’s best from the boats and the market.
paragraphs: Bring your team, clients, family or friends. For larger groups, we’ll put together a menu to share, tailored to your numbers, budget and dietary requirements.
For a gathering entirely your own, the whole restaurant is available for exclusive hire for lunch or dinner.
